name: @songjianbo/opus-decoder-sdk
description: 独立的 Opus 音频解码 SDK，支持 Ogg 容器解析、实时解码播放，无 UI 依赖
author: songjianbo

scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production npm run build:types && npm run build:types:save && vite build && npm run build:types && npm run build:types:restore
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:types && npm run build:types:save && vite build && npm run build:types && npm run build:types:restore
scripts.build:types:save: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('dist','src','sdk','index.d.ts');const dest='.temp-index.d.ts';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('✅ 类型定义文件已保存');}"
scripts.build:types:restore: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src='.temp-index.d.ts';const dest='dist/index.d.ts';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);fs.unlinkSync(src);console.log('✅ 类型定义文件已恢复到 dist/index.d.ts');}" && node merge-types.js
